newsitem.title: GERMANY: Hong Kong's Yam - 1997/98 budget is "fantastic".
newsitem.headline: Hong Kong's Yam - 1997/98 budget is "fantastic".

text.p: Joseph Yam, chief executive of the Hong Kong monetary authority, said the colony's 1997/98 budget passed on Wednesday is "fantastic."

Speaking at a conference on Hong Kong's monetary arrangements through 1997, Yam said, "it was a fantastic budget. I think the conservatism was appropriate and I think the deflationary stance is very appropriate."
He added that he did not think that a cut in the stamp duty would have undue negative economic consequences.

"I should not think cutting stamp duty in the budget will encourage (property) speculation and I do not think it will affect asset prices that much," he said. --Clifford Coonan, Frankfurt Newsroom + 49 69 756525
